---
title: "flaviLib 150x150 — Rank plots (v1, re-post-processed 261021)"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Built from `rank_plot_v9` (viromelib), adapted for flaviLib. One knit produces, for **each of the two
Mg2+ conditions**, an `all` and a `passing` rank plot as PDF / SVG / standalone interactive HTML / CSV —
plus a **combined** plot putting 10 mM against 1 mM for the same accession.

| what differs from the viromelib notebook | why |
|---|---|
| two conditions, looped | 10 mM and 1 mM were called separately and are not replicates of each other. They are never pooled |
| `MIN_REPS <- 2` of **four** | flaviLib has 4 replicates per condition (decision 26). 84 % of 10 mM sites pass in all four, so this gate does little work |
| **seven** CM columns | decisions 3/9/18: 1a, 1b, **1c**, 2, 3, 4, dumbbell — the same set as viromelib, so the legends match |
| `class1c` has its own colour | it is a *subclass of class 1*, not a sixth class, so it is drawn light purple: clearly in the class-1 family, clearly not 1a or 1b |
| `(no family assigned)` kept | 28 accessions have no family rank in NCBI (jingmenviruses, Shi-et-al. invertebrate viruses). 21 of the 699 10 mM sites are theirs and must not vanish |
| ranks on the site table | flaviLib's `rank_matches_input_stall_site_rank` is `false`; this notebook ranks on the p-value it reads and does not use `stall_site_rank` |

**How a point gets its colour.** `<model>.cm_hit` holds the cmsearch **E-value**. A *site* takes the model
with the lowest E-value among those hitting it — the most confident call — never a hand-set priority order,
which would settle a disagreement between two models by fiat and hide that it happened. An *accession* is
then coloured by the CM of its **own strongest site**, so the colour and the y-position describe the same
stall.

Measured on this dataset: **0 of 699 sites in 10 mM are hit by more than one CM**, so the tie-break is
currently inert. A 3'UTR may well carry both an xrRNA and a dumbbell, but they are different stalls, and
each stall gets one call. `cm_all` (with E-values), `cm_n_hits`, `cm_multi_hit` and `n_sites_with_cm` are
carried into the CSV and the hover text, and the knit prints a message if any multi-hit row appears.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(svglite)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(glue)
```

## Paths and configuration

```{r paths}
# Copy from the cluster:
#   $POSTPROC_BASE/<COND>/261021_flaviLib_150x150_<COND>.sites.csv
#   $POSTPROC_BASE/<COND>/261021_flaviLib_150x150_<COND>.peaks_annotated.csv
#   $ROOT/data/virus_taxonomy_flaviLib_261021.csv
# This notebook lives in BASE; inputs are shared with the input-distribution notebook, and each
# knit writes to its own dated, strategy-named folder under plots/ so successive strategies sit
# side by side instead of overwriting one another.
BASE    <- "~/Desktop/viromelib/flaviLib/figures/fig1_input_dist_rank_plot"
IN_DIR  <- file.path(BASE, "inputs")
STRATEGY <- "20261021_rank_2of4_percondition_plus_combined"
# peaks_annotated.csv (the "all" set) carries family/genus/species from post_process_peaks.py but
# NOT organism -- that is added later, by apply_publication_cutoffs.py, so only sites.csv has it.
# The taxonomy table supplies it for the "all" set.
TAX_CSV <- file.path(IN_DIR, "virus_taxonomy_flaviLib_261021.csv")
OUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE, "plots", STRATEGY)
dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

DS         <- "261021_flaviLib_150x150"
CONDITIONS <- c("10mM", "01mM")
COND_LABEL <- c("10mM" = "10 mM Mg2+", "01mM" = "1 mM Mg2+")

MIN_REPS <- 2            # of FOUR replicates (decision 26)
RANK_ON  <- "auto"       # "auto" = meta_pvalue if present, else meta_qvalue
TOP_N_LABELS <- 0
RING_HIGHLIGHTS <- FALSE

SZ_NONPASS <- 0.8
SZ_NOHIT   <- 1.3
SZ_CM      <- 3.0
A_NONPASS  <- 0.35

FIG_W <- 10; FIG_H <- 8

# Accessions to call out, as in the viromelib notebook. Verified present in the 1 mM table
# on 2026-10-21; every one of these resolves, so an unlabelled point means a real problem.
#
# Where a virus has several accessions in the library, the alternatives are listed in the comment
# so the choice is visible rather than buried:
#   West Nile virus       NC_009942.1 (lineage 1, NY99) | NC_001563.2 (lineage 2) | AY274504.1
#   Hepatitis C virus     NC_004102.1 (genotype 1a, H77) | NC_009827.1 | NC_009823.1
#                         | MH427312.1 | MN712204.1
# Note `species` holds the ICTV binomial (Orthoflavivirus nilense, zikaense, usutuense), so the
# common names below are ours; `organism` carries the familiar name where it is available.
#
# HEPATITIS C IS REMOVED, AND MUST NOT BE PUT BACK AS A NEGATIVE CONTROL.
# An earlier version of this file called it "a strong negative control: present in the library and
# not detected". That was WRONG, and the error is worth recording so it is not repeated.
#
# The control (R) libraries settle it (step 13c in the flaviLib run log). The five HCV accessions
# have 6-40 control reads per TILE against a library median of 91,847 -- 2,000 to 15,000x below.
# At that depth `stall_reads` can never reach the G1 threshold of 10, so HCV COULD NOT have been
# detected whatever its structure. Its apparent "best SF 1.000" is one or two reads at a position.
#
# "Present in the library but has no xrRNA" and "never assayed deeply enough to tell" are OPPOSITE
# claims. HCV supports only the second. Labelling it a negative control would assert the first.
#
# The mistake was reading zero passing sites from `peaks_annotated.csv` as evidence of absence.
# That table carries only `tile_reads_treated_*`; treated depth confounds representation with
# stalling, so a virus that degraded completely and a virus that was never there look identical.
# Representation can only be measured in the CONTROL libraries.
#
# A replacement is still needed (decision 30): an accession above the marginal band of the
# detectability floor with zero passing sites in BOTH conditions. Prefer a Hepacivirus or
# Pestivirus so the contrast stays inside Flaviviridae.
HIGHLIGHT <- tribble(
  ~accession,      ~highlight_name,
  "NC_012532.1",   "Zika virus",
  "NC_009942.1",   "West Nile virus",
  "NC_006551.1",   "Usutu virus",
  "NC_015843.2",   "Tembusu virus",
  "NC_024077.1",   "SbCNV-5"             # also in viromelib -- the one cross-library anchor.
                                         # PLLG clade member: its strong stalls have NO CM home
                                         # (decision 37), which the legend must state so it does
                                         # not read as missing annotation.
)
```

## CM models and colours

```{r cms}
# All seven annotated (decisions 3, 9, 18). The column name is "<model>.cm_hit".
CM_COLS <- c(
  class1a   = "CL_Class_1a_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class1b   = "CL_Class_1b_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class1c   = "class1c.cm_hit",
  class2    = "CL_Class_2_xrRNA_final.cm_hit",
  class3    = "cl3_NAR_2025.align.mpkadded.edited.confident.dedup.IDcurated.SS_cons.cm_hit",
  class4    = "class4_cl4_v9_20260824.cm_hit",
  dumbbell  = "dumbbell_RF00525.cm_hit"
)

# class1c is light purple: a class-1 subclass, visibly related to 1a/1b but distinct.
# dumbbell is amber, deliberately outside the class series, since it is a different element.
cm_colors <- c(
  class1a  = "#B5179E",   # magenta
  class1b  = "#7209B7",   # purple
  class1c  = "#C3A1E8",   # light purple  <- subclass of class 1
  class2   = "#3A0CA3",   # deep blue-purple
  class3   = "#1B998B",   # teal
  class4   = "#136F63",   # dark teal
  dumbbell = "#E9A23B",   # amber
  no_hit   = "#CCCCCC"
)
cm_labels <- c(
  class1a = "Class 1a", class1b = "Class 1b", class1c = "Class 1c",
  class2  = "Class 2",  class3  = "Class 3",  class4  = "Class 4",
  dumbbell = "Dumbbell", no_hit = "No hit"
)
# `<model>.cm_hit` holds the cmsearch E-VALUE, not a flag. A site is assigned the CM with the
# LOWEST E-value among those that hit it -- the most confident call -- never a hand-set priority
# order. Priority ordering would resolve a disagreement between two models by fiat and hide it.
# Measured on this dataset: 0 of 699 sites in 10 mM have more than one CM hit, so the rule is
# currently inert; it exists so that a multi-hit site is handled by evidence if one appears.
cm_order_for_display <- c("class1a", "class1b", "class1c", "class2", "class3", "class4", "dumbbell")

NO_FAMILY <- "(no family assigned)"
```

## Load one condition

```{r load_fn}
load_set <- function(cond, rank_set) {
  stopifnot(rank_set %in% c("all", "passing"))
  pfx <- file.path(IN_DIR, glue("{DS}_{cond}"))
  f <- if (rank_set == "passing") glue("{pfx}.sites.csv") else glue("{pfx}.peaks_annotated.csv")
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop(glue("missing input: {f}"))
  d <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)

  if (!"plain_accession" %in% names(d))
    d <- d %>% mutate(plain_accession = str_extract(accession, "^[^|]+"))
  d <- d %>% mutate(passed = !is.na(n_reps_passing) & as.integer(n_reps_passing) >= MIN_REPS)
  if (rank_set == "passing") d$passed <- TRUE

  # organism, for the "all" set
  if (!"organism" %in% names(d)) {
    if (!file.exists(TAX_CSV))
      stop(glue("{basename(f)} has no `organism` column and {basename(TAX_CSV)} is not in IN_DIR; ",
                "copy the taxonomy table across"))
    tx <- read_csv(TAX_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      select(plain_accession = accession, organism,
             tax_family = family, tax_species = species) %>%
      distinct(plain_accession, .keep_all = TRUE)
    d <- d %>% left_join(tx, by = "plain_accession")
    if (!"species" %in% names(d)) d$species <- d$tax_species
    if (!"family"  %in% names(d)) d$family  <- d$tax_family
    message(glue("  joined organism from {basename(TAX_CSV)}: ",
                 "{sum(!is.na(d$organism))}/{nrow(d)} rows"))
  }
  if (!"species" %in% names(d)) d$species <- NA_character_

  pcol <- if (RANK_ON != "auto") RANK_ON
          else if ("meta_pvalue" %in% names(d)) "meta_pvalue" else "meta_qvalue"

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(family  = ifelse(is.na(family) | family %in% c("", "nan"), NO_FAMILY, family),
           pval    = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.data[[pcol]])),
           log10p  = -log10(pmax(pval, 1e-300)))

  # E-value per model, NA where the model did not hit this site
  ev <- sapply(names(CM_COLS), function(k) {
    col <- CM_COLS[[k]]
    if (col %in% names(d)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d[[col]])))
    else rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
  })
  ev <- matrix(ev, nrow = nrow(d), dimnames = list(NULL, names(CM_COLS)))

  d$cm_n_hits <- rowSums(!is.na(ev))
  d$cm_class  <- apply(ev, 1, function(r)
    if (all(is.na(r))) "no_hit" else names(r)[which.min(r)])          # lowest E-value wins
  d$cm_class  <- replace_na(d$cm_class, "no_hit")   # an NA level adds a stray legend key
  d$cm_evalue <- apply(ev, 1, function(r) if (all(is.na(r))) NA_real_ else min(r, na.rm = TRUE))
  d$cm_all    <- apply(ev, 1, function(r) {
    h <- names(r)[!is.na(r)]
    if (!length(h)) "" else paste0(cm_labels[h], " (E=", signif(r[h], 2), ")",
                                   collapse = "; ")
  })
  if (any(d$cm_n_hits > 1))
    message(glue("  {sum(d$cm_n_hits > 1)} row(s) hit by more than one CM; ",
                 "assigned the lowest-E-value model, all listed in cm_all"))

  ranked <- d %>%
    group_by(plain_accession) %>%
    summarise(
      organism  = first(na.omit(organism)),
      species   = if ("species" %in% names(d)) first(na.omit(species)) else NA_character_,
      family    = first(family),
      n_rows    = n(),
      n_passing = sum(passed, na.rm = TRUE),
      best_log10p = max(log10p, na.rm = TRUE),
      # the accession is coloured by the CM of its OWN strongest site, not by a pick across sites
      cm_class     = cm_class[which.max(log10p)],
      cm_evalue    = cm_evalue[which.max(log10p)],
      cm_all       = cm_all[which.max(log10p)],
      cm_multi_hit = any(cm_n_hits > 1),
      n_sites_with_cm = sum(cm_n_hits > 0),
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(accession = plain_accession) %>%
    mutate(passed_any = n_passing > 0,
           condition  = cond, rank_set = rank_set) %>%
    arrange(desc(best_log10p)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number(),
           frac_rank = (rank - 1) / max(n() - 1, 1),
           cm_class = factor(cm_class, levels = names(cm_colors)),
           tip = glue("{coalesce(organism, '(no organism name)')}\n",
                      "{accession}  |  rank {rank}  |  {COND_LABEL[cond]}\n",
                      "{family}\n",
                      "CM at the strongest site: {ifelse(cm_all == '', 'none', cm_all)}\n",
                      "sites with a CM hit: {n_sites_with_cm} of {n_rows}\n",
                      "{n_passing} of {n_rows} candidate positions passed all gates in >={MIN_REPS} of 4 reps\n",
                      "strongest: -log10 {pcol} = {round(best_log10p, 2)}"))

  # highlights join on accession; anything absent is reported rather than silently unlabelled
  ranked <- ranked %>% left_join(HIGHLIGHT, by = "accession")
  miss <- setdiff(HIGHLIGHT$accession, ranked$accession)
  if (length(miss))
    message(glue("  HIGHLIGHT accessions absent from {cond}/{rank_set}: ",
                 "{paste(miss, collapse = ', ')}"))
  ranked$label_name <- coalesce(ranked$highlight_name, ranked$organism)

  message(glue("{cond} / {rank_set}: {nrow(ranked)} accessions, ",
               "{sum(ranked$passed_any)} stall-positive, ",
               "{sum(ranked$family == NO_FAMILY)} with no family, ranked on {pcol}"))
  list(data = ranked, pcol = pcol, cond = cond, rank_set = rank_set)
}
```

## Plot functions

```{r plot_fns}
# A CM class with no accessions gets a legend key with nothing to draw -- an empty box. This
# one-row-per-level layer has NA coordinates, so it renders no point but registers every level
# with the scale and the keys draw correctly. Same cause as the input-distribution figure.
# Must carry every column the plots map globally -- including `tip`, which interactive_plot
# puts in the base aes() and which this layer would otherwise inherit and fail to find.
legend_levels <- tibble(frac_rank = NA_real_, best_log10p = NA_real_,
                        p10 = NA_real_, p01 = NA_real_, tip = NA_character_,
                        cm_class = factor(names(cm_colors), levels = names(cm_colors)))

static_plot <- function(S) {
  d <- S$data; y_max <- max(d$best_log10p, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08
  label_df <- d %>%
    filter(!is.na(highlight_name) | (TOP_N_LABELS > 0 & rank <= TOP_N_LABELS)) %>%
    mutate(label_text = paste0(label_name, "\n", accession))

  ggplot(d, aes(x = frac_rank, y = best_log10p)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, !passed_any),
               colour = "grey82", size = SZ_NONPASS, alpha = A_NONPASS, shape = 1) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class == "no_hit"),
               colour = cm_colors[["no_hit"]], size = SZ_NOHIT, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class != "no_hit"),
               aes(fill = cm_class), shape = 21, size = SZ_CM, alpha = 1,
               colour = "grey25", stroke = 0.25) +
    {if (RING_HIGHLIGHTS)
       geom_point(data = label_df, shape = 21, size = SZ_CM + 1.6, stroke = 0.5,
                  colour = "grey35", fill = NA) else NULL} +
    geom_point(data = legend_levels, aes(fill = cm_class), shape = 21, size = SZ_CM,
               colour = "grey25", stroke = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, breaks = names(cm_colors),
                      labels = unname(cm_labels[names(cm_colors)]),
                      name = "CM class", drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    geom_label_repel(data = label_df, aes(label = label_text),
      colour = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 3.3, fill = alpha("white", 0.78),
      label.size = 0.25, label.padding = unit(0.25, "lines"), box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      point.padding = unit(0.45, "lines"), max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0,
      segment.colour = "grey40", segment.size = 0.4, direction = "y",
      nudge_x = 0.10, hjust = 0, force = 6, seed = 42, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(title = glue("flaviLib {COND_LABEL[S$cond]} ({S$rank_set}) — {nrow(d)} accessions, ",
                      "{sum(d$passed_any)} stall-positive"),
         subtitle = glue("ranked on {S$pcol} of the strongest site per genome; ",
                         "gate >= {MIN_REPS} of 4 replicates; ",
                         "{if (S$rank_set == 'all') 'open grey = no site passing the gates' else 'passing accessions only'}"),
         x = "Fractional rank (0 = strongest)",
         y = if (S$pcol == "meta_pvalue") expression(-log[10](p[meta])) else expression(-log[10](q[meta]))) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.02, 1.02), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40", hjust = 0.5),
          legend.position = "right",
          panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "#F0F0F0", linewidth = 0.3))
}

interactive_plot <- function(S) {
  d <- S$data
  p <- ggplot(d, aes(x = frac_rank, y = best_log10p, text = tip)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, !passed_any),
               colour = "grey82", size = SZ_NONPASS + 0.2, alpha = A_NONPASS, shape = 1) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class == "no_hit"),
               colour = cm_colors[["no_hit"]], size = SZ_NOHIT + 0.3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = filter(d, passed_any, cm_class != "no_hit"),
               aes(colour = cm_class), size = SZ_CM - 0.4, alpha = 1) +
    geom_point(data = legend_levels, aes(colour = cm_class), size = SZ_CM - 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cm_colors, breaks = names(cm_colors),
                        labels = unname(cm_labels[names(cm_colors)]),
                        name = "CM class", drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
    labs(x = "Fractional rank (0 = strongest)", y = glue("-log10 {S$pcol}"),
         title = glue("flaviLib {COND_LABEL[S$cond]} ({S$rank_set}) — hover for detail")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "right")
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    layout(hoverlabel = list(align = "left", font = list(size = 11)))
}
```

## Build every condition x set

```{r build, fig.width=10, fig.height=8, message=FALSE}
sets <- list()
for (cond in CONDITIONS) for (rs in c("all", "passing")) {
  S <- load_set(cond, rs)
  sets[[paste(cond, rs, sep = "_")]] <- S
  stem <- glue("rank_{cond}_{rs}")
  g <- static_plot(S)
  print(g)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, glue("{stem}.pdf")), g, width = FIG_W, height = FIG_H, device = cairo_pdf)
  ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, glue("{stem}.svg")), g, width = FIG_W, height = FIG_H)
  write_csv(S$data, file.path(OUT_DIR, glue("{stem}.csv")))
  saveWidget(interactive_plot(S), file.path(OUT_DIR, glue("{stem}.html")),
             selfcontained = TRUE, title = glue("flaviLib {cond} {rs}"))
}
```

## Combined: 10 mM against 1 mM

Same accession, both conditions. Points off the diagonal are Mg2+-dependent — the comparison this library
exists to make, and the one thing the per-condition plots cannot show.

```{r combined, fig.width=8, fig.height=7.5}
a <- sets[["10mM_passing"]]$data %>% select(accession, organism, family, cm_class, cm_all,
                                            hi = highlight_name, p10 = best_log10p)
b <- sets[["01mM_passing"]]$data %>% select(accession, p01 = best_log10p)
cmb <- full_join(a, b, by = "accession") %>%
  mutate(only_in = case_when(is.na(p01) ~ "10 mM only", is.na(p10) ~ "1 mM only", TRUE ~ "both"),
         p10 = replace_na(p10, 0), p01 = replace_na(p01, 0),
         cm_class = factor(replace_na(as.character(cm_class), "no_hit"), levels = names(cm_colors)))
message(glue("combined: {nrow(cmb)} accessions | both {sum(cmb$only_in=='both')} | ",
             "10 mM only {sum(cmb$only_in=='10 mM only')} | 1 mM only {sum(cmb$only_in=='1 mM only')}"))

lim <- c(0, max(c(cmb$p10, cmb$p01), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)
g <- ggplot(cmb, aes(p10, p01)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4, linetype = 2) +
  geom_point(data = filter(cmb, cm_class == "no_hit"),
             colour = cm_colors[["no_hit"]], size = SZ_NOHIT + 0.4, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = filter(cmb, cm_class != "no_hit"),
             aes(fill = cm_class), shape = 21, size = SZ_CM, colour = "grey25", stroke = 0.25) +
  geom_point(data = legend_levels, aes(fill = cm_class), shape = 21, size = SZ_CM,
             colour = "grey25", stroke = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_label_repel(data = filter(cmb, !is.na(hi)), aes(label = hi),
                   size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", fill = alpha("white", 0.8),
                   box.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"), max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 42) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cm_colors, breaks = names(cm_colors),
                    labels = unname(cm_labels[names(cm_colors)]),
                    name = "CM class", drop = FALSE, na.translate = FALSE) +
  coord_equal(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) +
  labs(title = "flaviLib: strongest site per genome, 10 mM vs 1 mM Mg2+",
       subtitle = glue("passing accessions in either condition; a 0 means no passing site in that ",
                       "condition. {sum(cmb$only_in != 'both')} accessions pass in one condition only"),
       x = expression(10~mM~Mg^"2+"~~-log[10](p[meta])),
       y = expression(1~mM~Mg^"2+"~~-log[10](p[meta]))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey40"))
g
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rank_combined_10mM_vs_01mM.pdf"), g, width = 8, height = 7.5, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "rank_combined_10mM_vs_01mM.svg"), g, width = 8, height = 7.5)
write_csv(cmb, file.path(OUT_DIR, "rank_combined_10mM_vs_01mM.csv"))
```

**Reading the zeros.** An accession with no passing site in one condition is plotted at 0 on that axis,
not dropped — otherwise the figure would show only the accessions that work in both and hide exactly the
Mg2+-dependent ones. The two bands along the axes are those accessions; the count is in the subtitle.

## Interactive versions, embedded

```{r embed, echo=FALSE}
htmltools::tagList(lapply(names(sets), function(k) {
  htmltools::tagList(htmltools::h3(k), interactive_plot(sets[[k]]))
}))
```

## CM class counts

```{r cm_counts}
bind_rows(lapply(names(sets), function(k)
  sets[[k]]$data %>% filter(passed_any) %>%
    count(condition, rank_set, cm_class) %>% mutate(set = k))) %>%
  filter(rank_set == "passing") %>%
  select(condition, cm_class, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(cm_class = cm_labels[as.character(cm_class)]) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Accessions by CM class (highest-priority hit), passing sets")
```
